content.title: Has Justin Rose won the Masters? Best finishes, history at Augusta National
content.text: Updated April 12, 2026, 6:58 p.m. ETEditor's Note: This story has been updated with new information. Follow along with live updates of all the final-round action at the Masters Tournament.In 2025, Rory McIlroy finally secured his long-awaited, coveted green jacket at Augusta National Golf Club after coming so close to it several times before.Justin Rose nearly followed in McIlroy's footsteps in the 90th edition of the Masters this year.The Englishman once again put himself in a position to challenge for the title in the final round Sunday, April 12, but a few miscues on the back nine kept him from securing his green jacket. There was a brief period where he was in first place after a flurry of birdies to end the front nine, but McIlroy surpassed him again and two-time Masters champion Scottie Scheffler also leapfrogged him on the back nine.Rose finished in a four-way tie for third with Tyrrell Hatton, Russell Henley and Cameron Young at 10-under par. McIlroy won his second consecutive Masters with a score of -12. Sheffler finished runner up, one stroke back.Rose nearly reached golf immortality last season when he rallied with a the back-nine tear, shooting 6-under 66 to get into a playoff with McIlroy, who eventually won on the first extra hole."I'm comfortable here but never complacent," Rose said after his third round on Saturday where he shot a 3-under 69. "I feel like there's always something to learn, something to push for. You've always got to respect the golf course.Here's what to know about Rose's history at Augusta National in the Masters: Justin Rose scorecard at Masters todayHere's a look at Rose's scorecard from Sunday's final round at The Masters:Birdie 3Par 5Bogey 5Par 3Birdie 3Par 3Birdie 3Birdie 4Birdie 3Par 4Bogey 5Bogey 4Par 5Par 4Birdie 4Par 3Bogey 5Par 4Has Justin Rose won the Masters?No, Rose has not received a green jacket in his career. He has, however, come close to winning at Augusta National on three separate occasions, including in last year's playoff loss to McIlroy.He is one of nine golfers to finish as the runner-up at least three times in the history of the Masters. He first finished as the runner-up in 2015, when he finished in a tie for second with Phil Mickelson and four strokes behind Jordan Spieth. He then finished as the runner-up in 2017 when he lost the first hole of the playoff with Sergio Garcia.Justin Rose finishes at the MastersThe 2026 Masters Tournament is Rose's 21st time playing at Augusta National. He's now finished in the top 25 in 16 of 21 trips to Augusta National.Here's a look at Rose's last finishes at the Masters going back to 2020:Score in parentheses2020: Tied for 23rd (-5)2021: Tied for 7th (-5)2022: Missed cut (+8)2023: Tied for 16th (-2)2024: Missed cut (+7)2025: Runner-up (-11)2026: Tied for 3rd (-10)Click here to view Rose's full career finishes at the Masters and Augusta National.
